Messages.Author: francoi...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
My Masika goes for bleed.
He's blocked, so he plays a Majesty (sup.) and untaps.
Then he plays a Portrait: will he be able to bleed again as a result of
the Portrait action?

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
francoi...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> My Masika goes for bleed.
> He's blocked, so he plays a Majesty (sup.) and untaps.
> Then he plays a Portrait: will he be able to bleed again as a result of
> the Portrait action?

No. If he cannot bleed his prey (for whatever reason: NRA, Minor Boon, etc.),
and the subject of the Portrait has a capacity between 7 and 10 inclusive,
then he merely untaps (card text) - he can't bleed.

Messages.Author: hamd...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
Further to this question, with The Portrait, are the effect cumulative -
eg, if the Vampire is a Nosferatu under 7, does the Burn 2 blood and
gain 2 blood apply? or if it is Harrod, does the acting vampire burn 3
blood?

DH



Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
hamd...@my-deja.com wrote:
> [...] with The Portrait, are the effect cumulative -

> eg, if the Vampire is a Nosferatu under 7, does the Burn 2 blood and
> gain 2 blood apply? or if it is Harrod, does the acting vampire burn 3
> blood?

Yes. All the effects are applied as appropriate.

First: pay 1 blood for the cost of the action.
Then: If Nosferatu: burn 2 blood.
Then: Gain 2, untap and bleed, or burn 1 blood based on the capacity.
